description.value: Cumberland Recreation Centre is a municipal community centre in the heart of the Village of Cumberland, a small town on Vancouver Island well known for its mountain biking trails and outdoor culture. The facility includes a climbing wall and offers drop-in programs and adult social activities. Touring cyclists passing through the Comox Valley will find it centrally located on Dunsmuir Avenue, Cumberland's main street.

The page was last reviewed February 5, 2026, and references 2026 fee changes, confirming it is open.
